scope: Five-source common-B mutable-source Q/R/X alphabet (PR1898). Even-subset readout on connector states of restored straight-line words with exactly seven queries. Exact minimum R among words with X=6.

claim.answers_7qxor_oq1: Minimum even-subset R among restored seven-query words with X=6 is exactly 82; R<=78 is impossible in this readout class, so the abstract tariff cannot undercut 436 via lower R at X=6.

one_repeat_spanning_five.argument: GL(5) reduces every spanning 5-set one-repeat covering walk to this basis census; R totals are invariant. Only R=96 occurs.

classification.argument: A covering even-subset slot list of length 7 must span F2^5, so it uses at least five linearly independent nonzero labels. With six intermediate slots after the leading 0, the covering cases are: (i) six distinct nonzero labels (Hamilton walks; R in {82,88}); (ii) five spanning nonzero labels with exactly one repeated vertex (R=96 on the GL(5) basis census). Fewer independent labels cannot cover. Therefore min R = 82.

xor_floor_citation.use_here: Together with min even-subset R=82, every X=6 word has R>=82.
